tabsHeading: Built to Solve Northeast India's Perishable Supply Chain
tabsDesc: Conventional wholesale mandis rely on multiple middlemen, delayed transit, and hazardous chemical preservatives. Here is how TazaHat changes the equation using modern engineering.
tabPerks: Agartala Central Cold Hub audited daily

tabContent.label: Origin & Mission
tabContent.title: Bridging Tripura's Traditional Bazaars with Next-Gen Tech
tabContent.lead: TazaHat was founded with an uncompromising mission: to rescue fresh food commerce in Northeast India from lengthy, opaque supply chains and chemical adulteration.

points.title: Direct Sourcing Infrastructure
points.desc: We buy directly at dawn from verified cultivators and river dock fishermen across Tripura, bypassing 3 to 5 exploitative intermediaries.

points.title: Fair Value for Producers
points.desc: Local farmers and fishermen earn 25-30% more compared to traditional mandi rates, backed by same-day digital settlements.

points.title: Radical Consumer Transparency
points.desc: Every vegetable bunch and fish order is traceable back to its source pond or cluster, offering complete peace of mind for families.

tabContent.label: Smart Cold Chain
tabContent.title: 0°C to 4°C Unbroken Cold Chain from Dock to Door
tabContent.lead: Freshwater fish and delicate organic produce lose nutritional value rapidly under humid tropical heat. Our micro-hubs deploy active thermal monitoring.

points.title: IoT Sensor Monitoring
points.desc: Real-time telemetry continuously logs storage temperatures inside our central Agartala hub and refrigerated fleet.

points.title: Formalin & Chemical Free Guarantee
points.desc: Zero chemical preservatives, zero ammonia sprays, and zero artificial coloring. Only clean food-grade flake ice and ozone purification.

points.title: Thermal-Shielded Delivery Packs
points.desc: Insulated, food-grade transit packaging guarantees produce arrives as crisp and fresh as when harvested at daybreak.

tabContent.label: Farmer Network
tabContent.title: Empowering 350+ Local Agritech Partners Across Tripura
tabContent.lead: We do not simply purchase crops; we invest in local agricultural prosperity by offering crop planning, modern organic guidance, and guaranteed off-take contracts.

points.title: Zero Middleman Commission
points.desc: Growers receive full market value without paying arbitrary mandi brokerages or enduring delayed credit cycles.

points.title: Demand Forecasting AI
points.desc: We share predictive harvest demands with our grower co-ops, drastically cutting post-harvest surplus and seasonal food loss.

points.title: Women & Youth Employment
points.desc: More than 65% of our sorting, quality inspection, and packaging team is drawn from rural and semi-urban communities in Tripura.

tabContent.label: Quality Protocol
tabContent.title: Triple-Point Quality Inspection Before Any Pack Leaves
tabContent.lead: We hold ourselves to standards that match the world's most rigorous grocery supply networks, adapted specifically for Northeast Indian produce.

points.title: Dawn Sorting & Grading
points.desc: Trained agrarian quality specialists grade produce based on firmness, natural color, aroma, and natural ripeness.

points.title: Ozonized Wash & Sanitization
points.desc: Vegetables and leafy greens undergo multi-stage ozonized water rinsing to eliminate surface dust and organic microbes without chemicals.

points.title: At-the-Door Open Box Inspection
points.desc: Customers are encouraged to inspect their fish and vegetables at their doorstep. If you are not delighted, return it instantly.

lifecycleHeading: How TazaHat Delivers In Hours, Not Days
lifecycleDesc: Every morning, before most of Tripura wakes up, our network is in full motion to bring you food at peak freshness.

lifecycleSteps.title: Dawn Harvest & Dock Catch
lifecycleSteps.desc: Produce is harvested and river fish collected at dawn from local Tripura ponds and farms under chilled holding conditions.

lifecycleSteps.title: Ozone Wash & Precision Sorting
lifecycleSteps.desc: Arrives at our central Agartala Cold Hub for inspection, chemical screening, ozonized cleaning, and grade-A sorting.

lifecycleSteps.title: Thermal Eco-Shield Packaging
lifecycleSteps.desc: Packaged in food-grade, breathable and insulated containers that maintain core temperature without artificial additives.

lifecycleSteps.title: Hyperlocal Doorstep Dispatch
lifecycleSteps.desc: Delivered to your kitchen via smart-routed delivery partners within guaranteed morning and evening fulfillment slots.

pillarsHeading: The Four Standards That Define TazaHat
pillarsDesc: Designed around safety, transparent economics, and customer-first values.

pillars.title: 100% Chemical-Free Freshness
pillars.desc: Zero formalin, zero wax coatings, and zero synthetic ripening agents. We test incoming catch so your family eats cleanly.

pillars.title: Direct-From-Source Pricing
pillars.desc: Cutting out multiple layers of brokerages allows us to offer honest prices for buyers and superior compensation for local growers.

pillars.title: Active Cold Chain & IoT Hubs
pillars.desc: Our localized Agartala fulfillment hubs preserve micro-nutrients and texture from receipt through last-mile delivery.

pillars.title: Open-Box Doorstep Verification
pillars.desc: Check every item with our delivery executive. Complete peace of mind with instant wallet credit or cash refund if dissatisfied.
